requirements.quote: If the copied packet arrives before the genuine packet, this will appear as a NAT rebinding.
requirements.condition: A copied genuine packet arrives before the original genuine packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint treats the observed path change as an apparent NAT rebinding.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver a forwarded copy before the original packet and inspect whether the endpoint processes the event as an apparent rebinding.

requirements.quote: Any genuine packet will be discarded as a duplicate.
requirements.condition: A forwarded copy of a genuine packet has already been received before the original genuine packet.
requirements.required_behavior: The subsequently received original genuine packet is discarded as a duplicate.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The subsequently received original genuine packet is processed as a new packet.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet delivery can be ordered so that a copy precedes the original, after which duplicate detection and packet processing are directly observable.

requirements.quote: A non-probing packet received on the original path that increases the maximum received packet number will cause the endpoint to move back to that path.
requirements.condition: The endpoint receives on the original path a non-probing packet whose packet number increases the maximum received packet number.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint moves the connection back to the original path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint remains migrated to the other path after accepting the qualifying packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish migration, inject a qualifying non-probing packet on the original path, and inspect the selected path afterward.

requirements.quote: In response to an apparent migration, endpoints MUST validate the previously active path using a PATH_CHALLENGE frame.
requirements.condition: An endpoint detects an apparent migration.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint validates the previously active path by sending a PATH_CHALLENGE frame on that path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint omits validation of the previously active path or performs it without a PATH_CHALLENGE frame.
requirements.why_checkable: A migration stimulus can be generated and outbound frames on the previously active path can be inspected for PATH_CHALLENGE.

requirements.quote: If the path is no longer viable, the validation attempt will time out and fail;
requirements.condition: Validation is attempted on a previously active path that is no longer viable.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint reports successful path validation without receiving a valid response.
requirements.error_behavior: The validation attempt times out and is marked failed.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can suppress all responses on the prior path and verify that validation eventually times out and transitions to failure.

requirements.quote: if the path is viable but no longer desired, the validation will succeed but only results in probing packets being sent on the path.
requirements.condition: The previously active path is viable but is no longer the desired path.
requirements.required_behavior: Validation of that path succeeds, and traffic caused on it by this validation is limited to probing packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint resumes sending non-probing traffic on that path solely because its validation succeeded.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can complete validation on a viable nonpreferred path and classify all subsequently induced packets there as probing or non-probing.

requirements.quote: An endpoint that receives a PATH_CHALLENGE on an active path SHOULD send a non-probing packet in response.
requirements.condition: An endpoint receives a PATH_CHALLENGE on an active path.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint sends a non-probing packet in response.
requirements.why_checkable: A PATH_CHALLENGE can be delivered on the active path and the endpoint's response can be inspected to determine whether it is non-probing.

requirements.quote: Any subsequent migration to another path restarts this entire process.
requirements.condition: A subsequent migration to another path occurs after the described defensive path-validation process has begun or completed.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint restarts the described defensive process for the new migration.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated migrations can be induced and observable validation and response behavior can be compared, but the phrase "entire process" does not precisely identify every operation that must restart.
